=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md:35,52,126-129,174-176,183,197,239,257,316 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Folding the readiness steps into the gated `pr-body-lint` job means a readiness script exit 1 (tracking-issue fetch or status-post failure) fails a check-run that is now in ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS_DEFAULT, so it widens what blocks merges.
  WHY: Today the `readiness` check-run is not gated, and the gate only supersedes cancelled runs (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:573-577), so a failed run keeps blocking. This contradicts the Goal of blocking exactly the same merges, and the Risks section omits it. Reviewers differ on whether the plan's exit-code claim is wrong (sonnet, luna) or only misleading (minimax, glm).
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md:116-131,175,237,239,245,252,257,294-305 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: OD1 recommends job id `pr-body-lint` and the workflow description, completion criteria and tests use it, but Implementation steps 1 and 6 select OD1 B (`pr-checks`), so the job-id instructions conflict.
  WHY: An implementer cannot satisfy both the steps and the gate list, completion criteria and tests. Disputed: sonnet rates it NIT (ambiguity only), and glm rejected it because OD1's "If B" line explains the parentheticals.
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md:214-217,225-226 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Jobs per pull request event" table's "Before" column names today's job `pr-body-lint`, but the actual job id is `lint` (.github/workflows/lint-pr-body-auto-close.yml:45) and no `pr-body-lint` job exists.
  WHY: The table contradicts the plan's own Context and OD1 and misleads baseline verification. Severity ranges from NIT (sonnet) to MAJOR (minimax, glm).
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md:178,182,301 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new enumeration command `git diff --no-renames --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD^1 HEAD` differs from the existing .github/workflows/lint-plan-archival.yml:61-62, which uses default rename detection, so pure moves into docs/completed/ are now listed as added.
  WHY: More files reach scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py, so archival PRs that pass today could fail, and the plan does not call this out. Severity ranges from NIT (sonnet, glm) to MAJOR (minimax).
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md:190-198,256 (README.md:148) | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: README.md:148 says the two removed workflows also have a job called `lint`, but the "Names that change" table and step 5 do not list this row for correction.
  WHY: After the fold the README names deleted workflows and a duplicate-`lint` condition that no longer holds. This was also reported as a task gap, rated MAJOR by gemini.
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md:237,245,252,257 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The "(OD1: B ...)" parentheticals in steps 1 and 6 read like instructions, so a reader could take OD1 B as chosen.
  WHY: This is a documentation ambiguity that could lead an implementer to the wrong job id.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh (CI check-runs `lint`, `static-checks` on head 6f8987575b46) | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both check-runs failed with `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed` because the merge ref is based on 595ee05 while main is at 7ab9c01.
  WHY: The log says this is not a defect in the PR, and only updating the branch from main clears it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The PR description says the plan "keeps every name that carries a verdict", has one job that "keeps the id `pr-body-lint`", and needs no manual ruleset steps, and that it "adds the folded job's name `pr-body-lint` to the merge gate's default list in the same PR".
  expected_change_site: PR description (author-controlled)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The plan now says no `pr-body-lint` job exists today and Phase 1 appends it to ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS_DEFAULT in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, but the description still describes the pre-autofix design and understates the Phase 1 scope.
- requirement: Plan must remove or correct all references to the old `lint` workflows, and the PR description requires "a table of every name that changes and every reader of it".
  expected_change_site: README.md:148 and the plan's "Names that change, and every reader" table / step 5
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The reader table and step 5 cover only the README `ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS` row, not the README.md:148 `AUTO_MERGE_REQUIRED_CI_CHECK` row.
- requirement: The folded job keeps a check-run name `pr-body-lint` that is added to ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS_DEFAULT in the same PR.
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md OD1 (lines 124-131) and job-id assertions (lines 175, 239, 252, 257, 294)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The plan recommends OD1 A but steps 1 and 6 instruct OD1 B (`pr-checks`), while step 6, the Phase 1 "Done when" criterion and the test still name `pr-body-lint`.
- requirement: "no check named `lint` outside `ci.yml`" (PR description Goals)
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md Phase 1 "Done when" (line 239) and Approach row (line 163)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The goal depends on OD2 A, and under OD2 B `lint-plan-archival.yml` would keep a `lint` job. The plan does not say which OD2 answer satisfies the goal.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md (Context bullet, D2, OD1, step 6, Risks; scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py:201-207; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:573-577) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan claims the readiness script "exits 1 only when it cannot post the status", but lines 202-207 return 1 whenever the tracking issue cannot be fetched. D2 and OD1/step 6 make the gated `pr-body-lint` job fail on any step failure.
  WHY: The gate treats only cancelled runs as supersedable, so a transient failure now blocks merges where `readiness` blocked nothing before. This contradicts the Goal, and the Risks section omits it.
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md ("The folded workflow" checkout bullet; step 1) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `--no-renames` differs from .github/workflows/lint-plan-archival.yml lines 61-62, which use default rename detection.
  WHY: Pure moves are now listed as added, so the linted set grows and a passing archival PR could fail.
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md (jobs-per-event table, "Before" column) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The table names `pr-body-lint` as today's job, but the job id is `lint` (.github/workflows/lint-pr-body-auto-close.yml line 45).
  WHY: It contradicts the plan's own baseline, though the counts are correct.
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md (steps 1 and 6 parentheticals vs Tests section) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "(OD1: B ...)" parentheticals read like instructions although the plan is consistent once OD1 is read.
  WHY: This is a documentation ambiguity that could lead to the wrong job id.
- docs/plans/fold-per-pr-checks-plan.md (CI check-runs `lint`, `static-checks` on head 6f8987575b46; scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both check-runs failed with `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed`.
  WHY: The log says this is not a PR defect, and only a branch update clears it.
- TASK_GAP: PR description vs plan | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: The PR description says the plan "keeps every name that carries a verdict", has one job that "keeps the id `pr-body-lint`", and needs "manual ruleset steps per repository (none required)".
  Expected change site: The PR description, which is author-controlled.
  Evidence of absence: The plan now says no job is named `pr-body-lint` today and that Phase 1 adds it to ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS_DEFAULT in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, plus the README and two tests. The description is stale and understates the scope.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
